anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broadly convex arc with a large radius relative to cranial height, creating a prominent, rounded bulbous shape.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio, exhibiting significant depth at the base relative to its forward projection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the steep melon slope transitions into the dorsal plane of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, light-colored linear mark is visible on the upper lateral flank posterior to the cranial region.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin features a distinct posterior margin characterized by a deep concave notch or indentation near its distal end.
